svg.title: Ask Artha read-only assistant architecture
svg.desc: Read-only assistant architecture using canonical database facts, bounded LLM intent selection, exact validation and application-owned generative UI.

g.text: Generative interaction, authoritative numbers and UI owned by the application.
The model chooses from facts; it does not invent balances, rows or calculations
Safe failure is part of the architecture
UI may show truthful progress states; private chain-of-thought is never exposed or required.
Database facts in. Safe repository UI out.
Read only • exact validation • explicit unavailable state
